attempted_claim: Let Y^lambda_mu be the truncated shifted Yangian of type D4 for g = so(8,C) at the concrete natural parameters lambda = 2*varpi_2 (twice the second fundamental coweight) and mu = 0, quantizing the corresponding affine Grassmannian slice. Let B(Y^lambda_mu) be its B-algebra (the Cartan quotient controlling highest weights, whose spectrum parametrizes highest-weight modules). Compute with proof the exact complex dimension dim_C B(Y^lambda_mu), and decide whether it equals both the cardinality of the type-D4 product monomial crystal at (lambda,mu) and the sum of Betti numbers / number of torus-fixed points of the associated Nakajima quiver variety. A complete answer states a specific explicit integer N and proves dim_C B = N by exhibiting N spanning weight vectors/monomials and proving linear independence (e.g. via localization or Groebner degeneration), together with a proof or disproof of the equality N = |product monomial crystal|, including the explicitly enumerated crystal count.
claim_type: exact dimension computation with crystal and geometric equality test
decisive_failure: The B-algebra ideal generators are unavailable beyond minuscule/type-A theory, so adjoint-node lifted minors and any Groebner or localization proof of dim_C B were not constructed; the crystal count alone cannot bound dim_C B; no preset fallback exists for this target-only topic, and no independently auditable adjacent alternative was available.
